world.title: البنية التحتية الممتدة عبر الدول تتطلب حماية تدوم لعقود.
world.body: من دلتا النيل إلى الخليج العربي، تتعرض خطوط الأنابيب والمنشآت التي تُشغّل الحضارة الحديثة لهجوم لا يتوقف. كل وصلة، وكل لحام، وكل سطح مكشوف هو خط دفاع أول.

problem.title: التآكل لا يُعلن عن نفسه.
problem.body1: إنه يعمل بصمت — داخل الأنابيب الناقلة للخام والمياه، وتحت العزل الحراري، وعلى طول البنية التحتية المدفونة. وبحلول الوقت الذي يصبح فيه مرئيًا، يكون الضرر الإنشائي قد بدأ بالفعل.
problem.body2: السؤال ليس أبدًا ما إذا كان التآكل سيحدث، بل ما إذا كان نظامك مصممًا هندسيًا لإيقافه قبل أن يوقفك.

story.title: قامت على مبدأ أن التآكل مشكلة هندسية — وليس قدرًا محتومًا.
story.p1: تأسست يونايتد سيرفيسز مصر عام 2005 على يد مجموعة من مهندسي البترول الذين أمضوا مسيرتهم المهنية وهم يشهدون كيف تستنزف أعطال التآكل التي يمكن تجنبها موارد كبرى شركات النفط والغاز في منطقة الشرق الأوسط وشمال أفريقيا.
story.p2: كانت قناعتهم أن حلول مكافحة التآكل المطابقة للمعايير الدولية — مثل تبطين GRE وطلاء FBE وأنظمة RTP — متاحة عالميًا لكنها كانت تُطبَّق بشكل غير متسق في مصر والمنطقة الأوسع، ويعود ذلك إلى حد كبير لنقص الخبرة الهندسية المحلية والقدرة التصنيعية المعتمدة.
story.p3: أُنشئت USE لسد هذه الفجوة. واليوم، ومن خلال منشأتنا المتكاملة للتصنيع والتطبيق البالغة مساحتها 6,000 متر مربع في القاهرة، نخدم الهيئة المصرية العامة للبترول وأدنوك وبي بي وشل وأكثر من خمس عشرة شركة تشغيل رئيسية أخرى في مصر والعراق والسعودية والإمارات.

tags.hdpe: PE100 / ASTM · Water Injection & Chemical Lines

imgAlt.gre: Technicians applying GRE lining to a steel pipe at the USE factory
imgAlt.wrap: Welder performing external wrapping application on steel pipe
imgAlt.coating: Industrial pipeline factory with coating equipment
imgAlt.hdpe: Stacked HDPE plastic pipes ready for installation
imgAlt.rtp: Large industrial spool of reinforced thermoplastic pipe

desc.gre: Glass Reinforced Epoxy (GRE) tubular lining provides a chemically inert internal barrier for steel pipelines carrying crude oil, produced water, and corrosive hydrocarbons. Applied in our 6,000 m² factory under API 15CLT and ISO 15996 quality regimes, USE GRE liners deliver service life exceeding 20 years in H₂S and CO₂ environments.
desc.wrap: Multi-layer cold-applied and heat-shrink tape systems for external pipeline protection against soil corrosion, mechanical damage, and UV degradation. USE external wrap systems are qualified to ISO 21809-3 and DIN 30672 and are used for both onshore buried pipelines and subsea risers across Egypt, Iraq, KSA, and UAE.
desc.coating: Fusion Bonded Epoxy (FBE) and liquid epoxy coating systems for internal and external pipeline protection. Applied at the USE facility using induction-heated pipe rotation equipment, our coatings meet NACE SP0188 and CSA Z245.20 standards. Suitable for water injection, crude service, and gas distribution pipelines.
desc.hdpe: High-Density Polyethylene (HDPE) slip-lining and factory-installed liner systems for water injection pipelines, chemical transport lines, and produced water reinjection systems. PE100 grade material conforming to ASTM D3350 and ISO 4427, providing full corrosion immunity and hydraulic efficiency improvement.
desc.rtp: Reinforced Thermoplastic Pipe (RTP) systems for oil, gas, and water service in corrosive environments where steel pipelines are uneconomical. USE RTP covers sizes DN40 to DN200 at operating pressures from 0.6 MPa to 32 MPa. Continuous-length manufacture minimises field joints; lightweight spooled delivery accelerates installation by up to 40% versus steel.
desc.rtv: Room Temperature Vulcanising (RTV) silicone coating for high-voltage ceramic and glass insulators operating in polluted environments including desert dust, salt fog, and industrial contamination. USE RTV coatings meet IEC 62073 and IEC 60815, extending insulator service life from 5 to 20+ years and eliminating scheduled insulator washing on transmission lines.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: United Services Egypt ("USE", "we", "us") respects your privacy. This policy explains what personal data we collect through use-eg.com and our client/candidate portals, why we collect it, and the choices you have.

dataCollected.title: 1. Data we collect
dataCollected.body: Account data (name, email, phone, company name) you provide at sign-up; candidate application data (date of birth, ID photo, CV) if you apply for a position; service requests, RFQs, and appointment bookings you submit; and technical data such as your IP-derived country, browser, and pages visited, used only in aggregate for site analytics.

howWeUseIt.title: 2. How we use it
howWeUseIt.body: To operate your account and the client/candidate portals, to process service requests, RFQs, and job applications, to communicate with you about those requests, to secure your account (including multi-factor authentication), and to understand aggregate site usage (e.g. which countries visit us) so we can improve the service.

legalBasis.title: 3. Legal basis for processing
legalBasis.body: We process your data to perform the contract between you and USE (e.g. fulfilling a service request), to comply with legal obligations, and on the basis of our legitimate interest in operating and securing our website and portals.

sharing.title: 4. Sharing your data
sharing.body: We do not sell personal data. We share it only with service providers who process it on our behalf under contract (cloud hosting, file storage, authentication, and logging providers), and only to the extent needed to provide the service.

cookies.title: 5. Cookies and similar technologies
cookies.body: We use strictly necessary cookies for authentication and session management. We do not use third-party advertising cookies.

retention.title: 6. Data retention
retention.body: We retain account and application data for as long as your account is active or as needed to provide the service, and for a reasonable period afterward to meet legal, accounting, or audit-trail obligations, after which it is deleted or anonymized.

security.title: 7. Security
security.body: We apply technical safeguards including encrypted TOTP secrets, private file storage accessed only via short-lived signed URLs, role-based access control so each user only ever sees their own data, and multi-factor authentication for administrator accounts.

yourRights.title: 8. Your rights
yourRights.body: You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data by contacting us at info@use-eg.com. We will respond within a reasonable timeframe.

children.title: 9. Children's privacy
children.body: Our services are intended for business use and job applicants of legal working age. We do not knowingly collect data from children.

changes.title: 10. Changes to this policy
changes.body: We may update this policy from time to time. Material changes will be reflected by an updated "last updated" date above.

contact.title: 11. Contact us
contact.body: For any privacy-related question, contact us at info@use-eg.com or 14S Building, El Oroba Street Extension, New Maadi, Cairo, Egypt.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.intro: These Terms of Use govern your access to and use of use-eg.com and the United Services Egypt ("USE") client and candidate portals. By using this site, you agree to these terms.

acceptance.title: 1. Acceptance of terms
acceptance.body: By creating an account, submitting a service request, or applying for a position through this site, you agree to be bound by these terms and our Privacy Policy.

accounts.title: 2. Accounts
accounts.body: You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials and for all activity under your account. Notify us immediately of any unauthorized use.

acceptableUse.title: 3. Acceptable use
acceptableUse.body: You agree not to misuse the site, including attempting to access another user's data, uploading malicious or disguised files, interfering with site security, or using the site for any unlawful purpose.

intellectualProperty.title: 4. Intellectual property
intellectualProperty.body: All content on this site — including text, graphics, logos, and the site design — is the property of United Services Egypt or its licensors and is protected by copyright and other intellectual property laws. See LICENSE and IMAGE_LICENSE for full terms.

imageLicense.title: 5. Image usage license
imageLicense.body: All photographs and images on this site, including photographs of our facilities, equipment, and completed projects, are the exclusive property of United Services Egypt. No image on this site may be copied, downloaded, reproduced, distributed, or used in any way, for any purpose, commercial or non-commercial, without our prior written consent. This restriction applies in full to any project photography added to the site in the future.

portalContent.title: 6. Content you submit
portalContent.body: You are responsible for the accuracy of information and files you submit (service requests, candidate applications, documents). We may reject or remove content that violates these terms, including files that fail our security screening.

disclaimer.title: 7. Disclaimer
disclaimer.body: This site and its content are provided "as is" without warranties of any kind, express or implied, to the fullest extent permitted by law.

liability.title: 8. Limitation of liability
liability.body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, United Services Egypt shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of this site.

termination.title: 9. Termination
termination.body: We may suspend or terminate your account at our discretion if you violate these terms, including attempting to access data that does not belong to you or uploading malicious content.

governingLaw.title: 10. Governing law
governingLaw.body: These terms are governed by the laws of the Arab Republic of Egypt.

changes.title: 11. Changes to these terms
changes.body: We may update these terms from time to time. Continued use of the site after changes take effect constitutes acceptance of the revised terms.

contact.title: 12. Contact us
contact.body: For any question about these terms, contact us at info@use-eg.com or 14S Building, El Oroba Street Extension, New Maadi, Cairo, Egypt.
